sense.text: Rebekah was barren, meaning she could not have babies. Isaac intreated the Lord for his wife, “and the Lord was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived”: she got pregnant.
“And the children struggled together within her”. “If it be so, why am I thus?”: if I be blessed by God, why am I having so much trouble in this childbirth? So she went to enquire of the Lord.

“Two nations are in thy womb”: this is the beginning of two nations, and the word Genesis means beginning. “And two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels”: two manner means two different types of people.

“The one people shall be stronger than the other people”, stronger mentally and physically. “And the elder shall serve the younger”: the elder was prophesied to be a servant to the younger.

There were twins in her womb, but those twins were not identical. It says two manner of people shall be separated. They looked different.

“And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.” Esau is red. When they are in the sun they get red; down south they call them rednecks, but it is not just their neck that gets red. Look at the people in France in the heat, how many of them died from heat stroke and heat exhaustion, and look how red they all are. Don’t tell me they white. The cloud in the back is white; their skin is red. They are Esau, and we don’t care whether you believe it or accept it. These are their children.

Esau means wasted away is he: his melanin was wasted away.

“And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau’s heel”. That is very important, because there is a lot of symbolism behind it: Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of the world that follows.

“Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them”: Isaac was 60 years old when Rebekah gave birth to Esau and Jacob.

The scriptures never mention Jacob’s color, because Jacob looked just like his mother and father. In fact Jacob looked like everybody from the time of Adam. The only color differential was Esau, and that is why the scribes had to write down Esau’s color: he was starkly different. Esau is the return of Cain’s lineage, and Jacob is the return of Seth.

“Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.” That is the two manner of people. Jacob was plain; he dwelt in tents and herded the sheep and the goats. Esau was not like that. He liked to go out and hunt; he liked that adrenaline rush.

“And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison”: Esau hunted the food and learned how to cook it from Rebekah. “But Rebekah loved Jacob.”

Esau came from the field faint from hunting in that hot sun; he almost caught a heat stroke. “Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage”: that same red pottage you are making right there, it look like me, I want to eat that thing. In that pottage was meat, raw meat, red and bloody. Jacob said it ain’t ready yet; Esau said I don’t care, I’ll eat it just the way it is.

“For I am faint”: I was just hunting, I’m tired, I ain’t catch nothing, I feel like I’m about to die. “Therefore was his name called Edom”: Edom means red.

“Sell me this day thy birthright.” Esau answered, “Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?” I don’t give a damn about a birthright if I’m about to die.

“And he sold his birthright unto Jacob.” This is what made him profane. “Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles”, and in those lentils was raw meat. “Thus Esau despised his birthright.”

precepts.why:
What did it mean, the younger one holding Esau’s heel? Ezra asked, “What shall be the parting asunder of the times? or when shall be the end of the first, and the beginning of it that followeth?” When shall be the end of the world, and when shall the new world come in?

The answer goes straight to the twins: “From Abraham unto Isaac, when Jacob and Esau were born of him, Jacob’s hand held first the heel of Esau. For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.” That is what it symbolized when Jacob held Esau’s heel. Esau is the end of this world, and Jacob is the beginning of the world that follows.

“The hand of man is betwixt the heel and the hand”: all the other nations are in between, like extras in the movie. Moab is an extra, Ishmael is an extra; they are all extras. “Other question, Esdras, ask thou not.” Christians don’t know what Genesis 25:26 means at all; now we know.

“And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground”. The dust of the ground is different shades of brown, and the deeper you dig, the darker it gets. That is what Adam looked like, and Eve, and everybody that came from them.

When the lack of melanin came in as a curse, you had Cain. The flood came and killed them all off, and God brought everyone back through Noah’s three sons. Move up the generational line to Isaac and Rebekah, and they gave birth to Esau and Jacob: Esau is the return of Cain’s lineage, and Jacob is the return of Seth. That is why only Esau’s color was written down when he came out red.

“Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.” This lets you know that in that red pottage was meat. When Genesis 25 says “Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage”, it was raw meat in there.

Why is Esau called profane? The birthright meant a lot, and he could not care less about it. He sold it for a morsel of meat.

“For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.” When Esau would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected by God.

Many brothers ask what it means that Esau was a fornicator. “Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.” His parents did not like his marriage choices.

Unlearned Israelites use these two verses to say Esau was black, because his children were mixed with the Hittites. No. God kept that line pure the way it is. Even today, no matter how black you are, marry a white woman and you can tell that child is a hybrid: high yellow, yellow hair sometimes, green eyes. Look at Drake: his hair is like his father’s, but his complexion is closer to his mother’s. So you mean back then God couldn’t maintain that same lighter red complexion? Shut up, Negro. Be quiet. Those hybrid children look more like Esau.

“And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father”: Esau saw that Isaac was angry that he married the daughters of Canaan. “Then went Esau unto Ishmael”, and took “Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.”

So now he married the Arab children. That is what Esau was doing: taking wives of other nations, which is why he is called a fornicator.

“Beware of all whoredom, my son”. Whoredom falls under fornication, and Hebrews calls Esau a fornicator. Tobit explains it: “chiefly take a wife of the seed of thy fathers, and take not a strange woman to wife, which is not of thy father’s tribe”.

Esau married Hittite women, and he married an Ishmaelite woman. Ishmael was the beginning of another race; remember Genesis is the beginning of races.

“For we are the children of the prophets, Noe, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: remember, my son, that our fathers from the beginning, even that they all married wives of their own kindred, and were blessed in their children, and their seed shall inherit the land.” Esau did the opposite.

sense.text:
Remember the chapter. Rebekah told Jacob, your father is half blind; go in there and make believe you are your brother Esau. Jacob said, but I’ll get cursed. She said whatever curse there be, let it fall on me. Why did she say that? Because she remembered what God told her when she was giving birth: the elder shall serve the younger. She put goat’s hair on Jacob’s hands and the back of his neck, so that when his father felt him he would feel hairy like Esau. Isaac said, you sound like Jacob, but you feel and smell like Esau: you smell like outside, you smell like dog. And Isaac blessed Jacob with the major blessing, thinking it was Esau.

Ask the Christians about those two boys and they say Jacob was the evil son and Esau the good one, because Jacob supplanted Esau, and black people in church echo the same thing. No. Jacob was the good one. Esau was the profane one, the fornicating one, the one that hated his birthright. What Jacob did was due to his mother, and she was being obedient to God.

“Hast thou but one blessing, my father?” You only got one blessing, and you gave it to Jacob. “Bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.”

“Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth”: prophetically, Esau, you are going to live in the best places. “And of the dew of heaven from above”: dew falls everywhere, and wherever the dew falls, that is where you are going to live. You will live where you want, and you will have the best places on the planet.

How would Esau get the best places? “And by thy sword shalt thou live”: Esau lives by the sword, meaning war. That is how they would get the fatness of the land: through war. God through Isaac blessed Esau with the art of war, the same blessing Cain had, as Deacon Ethan brought up. Remember Cain’s line, Tubalcain, made all kinds of weapons; Esau got the same blessing as Cain.

“And shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.” The first time that happened was in the days of Jehoram.

Then Edom aided the Babylonian empire in the destruction of the first temple in 586 BCE, rather than helping Judah, their brother. The brother of the Israelites helped the Babylonians, who were Kushites, destroy the first temple. They rejoiced, looted the city, blocked the survivors who fled, and took part in the razing, the destroying of Solomon’s temple.

precepts.why:
When did Esau first break the yoke? “In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.”

Whose days? Read from verse 16: “Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign. Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem. And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Ahab: for the daughter of Ahab was his wife: and he did evil in the sight of the Lord. Yet the Lord would not destroy Judah for David his servant’s sake”.

In the days of Jehoram, Edom revolted and made its own king. That is the first fulfilment of Genesis 27:40, “thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.”

“The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom”. The whole chapter is about Edom and what they did.

“In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.” Even Edom was as one of them.

“But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger”: the day your brother Jacob became a stranger, and the twelve tribes did become strangers. “Neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction”: they rejoiced when we got destroyed.

“Nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity”: they laid hands on us; they were robbing us too. “Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress.” When we were escaping, Edom blocked our way, held us in, and gave us up to the Babylonians.

Peep what Edom did: “Thou also hast vowed to build up the temple, which the Edomites burned when Judea was made desolate by the Chaldees.”

So who burned the temple? Edom. When Babylon came against Judea, it was Edom that burned up the temple, living by the sword against their own brother.

sense.text:
“Simeon that was called Niger”. The word Negro is derived from the Latin word for black, and Niger is a Latin word that was used by the Moors and the old Romans to designate any black. The Negro was called a Moor, a blackamoor.

It was never a derogatory word. It was a name a teacher of the church at Antioch was called by. Esau made it derogatory, and many of you today take it as derogatory. Oh, I’m offended by that word. Shut up. Be quiet.

“The word of the Lord that came to Micah the Morasthite”. The word Moor is in the Bible: Micah the Morasthite was a prophet of the Moors, a teacher of the Moors, and he spake to all the people of Judah, the Moors, meaning the blacks.

The Moors were Israelites. Israel went into the Assyrian captivity, the Babylonian, the Persian and Median, the Greek and then the Roman; about 600 years after the Roman captivity of 70 AD, around 711, Israelites called Moors went into Spain. They brought universities into Europe. They brought soap, and the holy water to disinfect the sick that is now called rubbing alcohol. They brought strawberries, olives and grapes into Europe, taught Europeans how to make wine, and brought the game of chess, and everybody thinks the white man made that up.

They say the Moors were Africans, but Africa is a name that came way later. The Latins, who later became known as the Romans, gave the name Africa to the region around Carthage and Utica. The white man put that name on us. We are not Africans. We have to go back to the name God calls us.

Anytime we are set somewhere, we rise up as a nation. So the Lord allows Esau to conquer us. Why? Because the saviour is Christ. If we could do it without Christ, why would we need Christ? When the white man conquered the Moors, they celebrated, and in Spain they celebrate it to this day: dressing as Moors in blackface with big red lips, all mockery. They remember that we ruled them, and they said we can never let them rise again.

That is why they destroyed Black Wall Street: our economy was better than theirs, 35 blocks, our own houses, our own everything. The same with Rosewood and Lake Lanier: we were doing better than them, so they bombed us with dynamite, killed us, pushed us out of our homes and took our lands and property. Esau knows what happened: these people used to rule us; never let them rise up again. So the Moors were conquered and scattered.

precepts.why:
“Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spake to all the people of Judah”: he spake to the people of Judah, the Moors, the blacks.

“Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.” Micah shows the wrath of God against Jacob for idolatry.

“Then Solomon began to build the house of the Lord at Jerusalem in mount Moriah”. Mount Moriah, meaning Moor right there, black again, “where the Lord appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.”

This shows that the hill of the Moors was part of Jerusalem. Moriah was a hill adjacent to Jerusalem on the northeast. There Abraham offered his son, and when Solomon built the temple on it, it became included in the city. Masarath was built by the Moors in the desert of Paran, in the land of Amalek; it was the ancient encampment of Israel in the days of Moses. And in the Moorish war of Adel in Africa, some of the books of Moses were burnt.

sense.text:
The Moors that were conquered and scattered were sent to Africa, to Brazil and to North America.

This is King David. When he ruled, Babylon was not in power, but he saw a vision of the destruction of the nation of Israel. “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” Rase it means destroy it. That is what Edom did when they burned down that temple.

“O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed”. He calls Edom the daughter of Babylon, because they assisted the Kushite Babylonians. The prophecy is that the daughter of Babylon is to be destroyed. “Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.”
“Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.” That is what they did to our children.

Those Moors who were conquered were taken back to Africa as slaves and then transported to Brazil and North America, and they are all Israelites. “Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north”: North America. “For I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven”.

“Deliver thyself, O Zion”. That Zion is Judah: deliver thyself, O Judah, “that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon”, that dwells with Edom, Edom in North America.

Benjamin does not dwell with the daughter of Babylon; they are on a nice, pleasant island. Levi does not dwell with the daughter of Babylon. That is why all the tribes make fun of Judah: we got places to go back to when we want to run; y’all got no place to go. Why? Because Judah dwells with the daughter of Babylon.

That is not to say all Judah is in North America. Zechariah is pointing out a remnant of Judah that is in North America. What is so special about this group? The House of David is here.
“After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.” Whoever touches Judah touches God’s favourite.

“For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants”. Edom shall be a spoil to us; we are the servants here. “And ye shall know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me.”

precepts.why: “But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.” This is how we know the Zion of Zechariah 2:7 is Judah: the Lord chose the tribe of Judah, mount Zion. So “Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon” is Judah, dwelling with Edom.

People hear us teach and say, oh, you’re saying all Judah is in North America. No, that is not what we’re saying. Just as all Levi is not on the island of Haiti, and all Benjamin is not on the island of Jamaica or Trinidad.

“And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.” Israel and Judah were scattered worldwide. Zechariah is pointing out a remnant of Judah in North America, and the House of David is here.

Why are they so hard on Judah here, as opposed to Judah scattered elsewhere? The United States Senate hearings on civil rights of 1959, on American Negro problems: Negroes are everywhere, in Jamaica, Haiti, Africa, Saudi Arabia, but it pinpoints the American Negro. The white man examined all the Negro populations and said the Negroes of the United States are the most advanced section of the Negro population of the world, and can play a decisive role in leading the liberation movement of the Negroes everywhere.

When Babylon came against Judah, they took the most educated. At Elmina Castle in Ghana, the guide said it himself: they took the best when they came to Africa, and that is why the American black is more advanced and Africa is always behind. Look what the blacks here did right after slavery, with no reparations, before they came and dropped bombs and destroyed them. Esau knows that history.

“And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring certain of the children of Israel, and of the king’s seed, and of the princes; Children in whom was no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science, and such as had ability in them to stand in the king’s palace”. Esau did the same thing. They didn’t take any old body. They said we need the best ones, and put them in North America.

The Negro working class here is destined, they wrote, to be the vanguard of all the liberation movements. That is why Esau always has his eye on the American blacks. People ask why Canada and Europe have free healthcare and America does not: they don’t want the American blacks to get it, because that group is more dangerous than all the other groups of blacks. Sisters, don’t just let your boys run out. The white man has his eyes on your sons. They know what stock they come from.

The white man’s own book says a strong Negro movement in the USA will be able to influence and direct the Negro movement in all the backward parts of the world. That is the American Negro, that is Judah, and this history we should be proud of. Don’t be mad; be glad.

“The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first”. That is what the white man knows. It ain’t Judah over in Africa, it ain’t Judah in Saudi Arabia: it is Judah here, and the Lord will raise them up first.

Sisters with black sons whose father was no good: he is still of good stock. You better be glad your son’s daddy is a Negro. There is still hope for him.

“And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people”. Judah is going to be the one teaching and preaching, and he is the one that is going to know where the tribes are. That is the American Negro they said would lead all the others. “Let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.”

The American Economic Association wrote that the Negro stock landed in America was probably physically superior to the average of that left behind: the great majority, being by nature the soundest and strongest, recovered and passed on their quality to their offspring. We didn’t write that; the white man wrote that. They examined all the blacks wherever their slaves were, and said the American Negro was the one.

A lot of black women don’t understand this. “My son, keep the flower of thine age sound; and give not thy strength to strangers.” Don’t give your strength to other nations, or wicked women.

“When thou hast gotten a fruitful possession through all the field, sow it with thine own seed”: sow it with your own race, “trusting in the goodness of thy stock.” You Negroes, that is good stock right there, and some of you are ashamed of it.

“So thy race which thou leavest shall be magnified, having the confidence of their good descent.” The word race is in the Bible, in terms of your nationality. That is what our sons and daughters have to know, instead of running around giving their seed to any old thing out there in the world.

sense.text:
“And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city”. We are not physically dead, but mentally and spiritually we are a dead race of people. The great city is Babylon.

“Which spiritually is called Sodom”: this is not the real Sodom, but a spiritual Sodom. Babylon the Great, which is the United States of America, is a spiritual Sodom: same-sex marriages, transgenderism, all kind of filth, bestiality.

“And Egypt”: not the real Egypt, but a spiritual Egypt. That is why the Egyptian pyramid is on the back of the dollar bill, with the all-seeing eye of Horus at the top and 1776 at the bottom. Novus ordo seclorum: the secular new world order. Annuit coeptis: our enterprise of success.

“Where also our Lord was crucified”: our Lord was crucified in Jerusalem. This is not the real Jerusalem, but a spiritual Jerusalem, because our people here hate the real biblical Christ, that black Christ. They hate his guts and his teachings of the law, and they want him dead. They want a white Jesus who teaches love for everybody: if it feels good, just do it. Our own people do that.

precepts.why: What is the biblical name of the great city? “Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city”. Babylon is that great city, so the dead bodies of Revelation 11:8 lie in the street of Babylon.
“The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.” We wandered out of the way of understanding God’s laws. We are the congregation of the dead.

“O Lord Almighty, thou God of Israel, hear now the prayers of the dead Israelites”. He is calling us the dead Israelites. We are not physically dead, but spiritually we are a dead race of people, filled with hatred, filled with adulteries, filled with pornographies; some are child molesters, drug dealers, drug users, drug abusers. We hate each other and can’t get along. That is why it calls us the dead Israelites.

“And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication: And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY”.

Why does it say mystery first? Because when you tell our people this is Babylon the Great, they say impossible, Babylon the Great is Iraq. That is what they learn among the Jehovah’s Witnesses and the Seventh-day Adventists. But it is the United States of America, and it is a mystery: the same place that destroyed us is the same place that feeds us, gives us Medicaid, Section 8 housing, homes, education.

“BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS”. You know what the mother of harlots is called? A madam: for a man they call it a pimp, for a woman a madam, and she has a bunch of harlots running around having sex with everybody. America sends out the CIA and its religious leaders. Russia shut down the Jehovah’s Witnesses and seized all their properties, because their headquarters is here and they were bringing back information: spies. Russia ain’t stupid. Mother Teresa was a CIA operative as well.

“AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH”: same-sex, which they push everywhere. They send their operatives all over saying accept same-sex, and when they talk about human rights, they are talking about man with man and woman with woman.

Some say the mother of harlots is the Vatican. “And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.” The nation that reigns over the kings of the earth is the United States of America, not the Vatican, and this is where they keep their harlots, in over 850 bases everywhere.

sense.text:
“This is the word of the Lord unto Zerubbabel”. Zerubbabel means born in Babylon, or seed of Babylon; some note it could also be read as born in exile, but the standard rendering is born in Babylon. One of our forefathers was named born in Babylon.

“Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the Lord of hosts.” You have to ask why the Lord said that to Zerubbabel. Zerubbabel was one of the king’s three bodyguards. The Persian king’s personal bodyguards were chosen from the 10,000 Immortals, an elite standing force, and selection required strict nobility, extreme physical endurance, proven combat skill and unwavering personal loyalty to the king. People had to see you at war. They also required character and honour: a cultural emphasis on truth and moral discipline. Out of the 10,000, the innermost personal guard protecting the king directly was 1,000 premier soldiers, the apple bearers, with golden pomegranates on their spears where the other 9,000 carried silver. That is where Zerubbabel was.

Why would such a warrior serve the Persian king with loyalty? If you are the top fighter but nobody else is, and they have knives to everybody’s throat, saying if you don’t give up we kill everybody, what would you do? Keep fighting and your mother is dead, your father is dead, your kids are dead. Zerubbabel did not fight. He said, if I fight they all die; I might live, but they are going to die. So he became the king’s bodyguard.

That is how he became one of the top three: honour, discipline, morality. Captains, check the men you put on security. A brother just off the street slinging drugs, an 18-year-old who was watching porn last night, men who don’t know the scriptures, have no discipline and are immoral: they will sell you out. That is the captain’s fault. You have to build these brothers.

precepts.why:
“Then three young men, that were of the guard that kept the king’s body, spake one to another”. These three were the king’s bodyguard, and Zerubbabel was one of them.

The king set forth a contest: whoever gives the wisest saying about what is the strongest, I will give him wealth, fame and fortune, and he can sit beside me. The three bodyguards accepted the challenge.
“The first wrote, Wine is the strongest. The second wrote, The king is strongest. The third wrote, Women are strongest: but above all things Truth beareth away the victory.” The third was Zerubbabel.

“Then the third, who had spoken of women, and of the truth, (this was Zorobabel) began to speak. O ye men, it is not the great king, nor the multitude of men, neither is it wine, that excelleth”. He cut down the one who said the king is strongest; that one wanted brownie points.

“Women have borne the king”. “These also make garments for men”: women, if your mama never taught you to sew, why not learn? “These bring glory unto men”, and not with a bonnet and pajamas on; that ain’t glory, that’s humiliation. “Do they not love a woman which is comely in favour and beauty?” Sister, don’t let yourself go after you get married. And you don’t all have a thyroid problem.

“Have not all men more desire unto her than unto silver or gold”? Why do you think brothers get in the drug game? Money, power, respect, to get the woman. And when the cops come, she says she didn’t know he was a drug dealer. How did he get all them vehicles and that mansion with no job? You knew.

“A man leaveth his own father that brought him up, and his own country, and cleaveth unto his wife.” Brothers, to do that you have to have a job. A young man who keeps getting fired can’t get married, unless he finds a woman to pay his rent and buy his drawers. “Do ye not labour and toil, and give and bring all to the woman?” A man is content with a studio and an air mattress; the woman needs three bedrooms, two bathrooms and drapes. “A man taketh his sword, and goeth his way to rob and to steal”, and “he bringeth it to his love.”

“Many there be that have run out of their wits for women, and become servants for their sakes.” What kind of man is that? A simp. All she has to do is use her pinky, and 300 pounds of muscle goes to fight a man because she said he looked at her, and ends up in jail, and she goes and finds another simp. “Many also have perished, have erred, and sinned, for women”, and a lot of them are in jail today.

Then the king: Apame the king’s concubine was “taking the crown from the king’s head, and setting it upon her own head; she also struck the king with her left hand. And yet for all this the king gaped and gazed upon her with open mouth: if she laughed upon him, he laughed also”. He was fain to flatter so she would be reconciled to him again. “Then the king and the princes looked one upon another”: they were shocked. Zerubbabel had told the king to his face that a woman smacked him and took the crown off his head.

Then he spoke of the truth of God: “great is the truth, and stronger than all things.” “Wine is wicked, the king is wicked, women are wicked, all the children of men are wicked”: he called the king wicked in his face. This is a bold brother. “With her there is no accepting of persons or rewards”: that is why he could tell the king like it is, with no partiality. “Blessed be the God of truth.” And the people said, “Great is Truth, and mighty above all things.”

The king said, “Ask what thou wilt more than is appointed in the writing”. How noble was our forefather? He asked nothing for himself: “Remember thy vow, which thou hast vowed to build Jerusalem”, to send back the vessels, and to build up the temple “which the Edomites burned”. He didn’t say give me silver, give me gold, give me this woman to marry. That should not be our mentality either.

Darius “stood up, and kissed him”, on the cheek, the custom in the east, not on the lips, you little sodomites, and wrote letters to convey him and all those going up “to build Jerusalem”, to bring cedar wood from Libanus, and for the freedom of the Jews, that their country “should be free without tribute”, no taxes. “And that the Edomites should give over the villages of the Jews which then they held”: after Edom burned the temple, they took over the land, and now they had to get out of our land.

sense.text: In the Persian captivity there was Joshua the high priest, of the tribe of Levi, and Zerubbabel the governor, of the tribe of Judah. “For, behold, I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH”: the Branch is Christ.
“Upon one stone shall be seven eyes”: those are the angels. “And I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day”: that is Christ dying on the cross.
“Shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree”: that is in the kingdom.

precepts.why: “Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.” The righteous Branch raised unto David is Christ. “In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.”

“Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the Lord”: not the second temple, but the third and the fourth.

“He shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both”: between the priesthood and the kingship. Christ fulfils both. That is why Zechariah 3 speaks to Joshua the high priest, and Zechariah 4 to Zerubbabel the governor.

“The sceptre shall not depart from Judah”: the kingship shall not depart from Judah. “Nor a lawgiver from between his feet”: that is the priesthood. And what is between your feet, brothers? Your rod. It lets you know Christ would come from the rod. There is no immaculate nothing; that is make-believe, Egyptian and Babylonian fairy tales. “Until Shiloh come”: Shiloh is the Messiah, Christ. “And unto him shall the gathering of the people be.”

“And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel”, down to “Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.” That is the Branch, right there, from Zerubbabel.

Some say there was a curse on Jechonias that nobody of his line would sit as king, so the genealogy is ruled out. But after Jechonias, was there a king in Israel sitting on the throne? No. When Babylon came in, that was it: Zedekiah came, they killed him with his sons. There was no king in the time of Christ.

“When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.” That is how much Israel loved him: they wanted him to be their king, and he said no. Why? Because by the prophets there would be no more king until Christ returns.

sense.text: Now we know why the Lord said this to Zerubbabel. He was of the king’s bodyguard, one of the top fighters. The Lord is telling him this has nothing to do with your fighting skills; we know you could break bones, but that is not what is going to overcome everything. “Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the Lord of hosts”: the spirit of the Lord is what is going to do it.

“Who art thou, O great mountain?” The great mountain is Babylon the Great. “Before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain”: flattened, destroyed. “And he shall bring forth the headstone thereof”: not only would Christ come from Zerubbabel’s lineage, he would bring him forth, “with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it”: crying mercy, mercy.

“The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it”. His hands started the foundation of the temple, and he did finish it. But this goes deeper than that: going by verse 7, verses 6 to 9 speak of the last days as well.

precepts.why: “The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.” That is Christ. He is the headstone that Zerubbabel shall bring forth.

“And the elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they builded, and finished it”. “And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.”

Why did the Lord call Haggai and Zechariah? To get on Zerubbabel and the people to continue building the temple. Zerubbabel and Joshua had stopped building because they were hindered by the other nations. God sent those two prophets to blast the high priest and the governor so they would go back to the work, and they finished it in the sixth year of Darius.

sense.text: Here is the proof. “Came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest”. The word came by Haggai to the governor and to the high priest.

“This people say, The time is not come, the time that the Lord’s house should be built.” With all the other nations hindering them, everybody was discouraged: maybe this ain’t the time for the temple to be built.

“Is it time for you, O ye, to dwell in your cieled houses, and this house lie waste?” Hey, Zerubbabel, is it time for you to live in your nice little house over there? I see you got a new roof. Look at the Lord’s house: it’s a shambles.

“Consider your ways”: examine yourself. And that is not only for Zerubbabel.

“Ye have sown much, and bring in little”: you have worked a lot and have little profit to show for it. “Ye eat, but ye have not enough”; “ye clothe you, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes.” Some of you have jobs: I just worked 48, 52 hours, and I ain’t got enough money to show for it. That is why many of us are always struggling: God is always second or third in your life, just like with Zerubbabel.

“Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house”. “Ye looked for much, and, lo, it came to little; and when ye brought it home, I did blow upon it. Why? saith the Lord of hosts. Because of mine house that is waste, and ye run every man unto his own house.” You are not looking after my house first.

“Therefore the heaven over you is stayed from dew, and the earth is stayed from her fruit”: no rain, no blessings in your crops. Then the drought upon all the labour of the hands.

“Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the Lord their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet”.

Joshua was the high priest and Zerubbabel the governor; Haggai was in neither position. But Joshua and Zerubbabel humbled themselves, because they knew it was the word of the Lord. They didn’t say arrest him, lock him up, and Zerubbabel could have punched a hole in his chest. He recognised the word of the Lord and humbled himself.

That is how we have to be. Brothers take correction personally, as if we stabbed their mama; correct a brother’s wife and he says you are trying to destroy his marriage. No, we are trying to help. That’s love.

“I am with you, saith the Lord. And the Lord stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel”, and of Joshua, and of all the remnant of the people, “and they came and did work in the house of the Lord of hosts, their God”.

precepts.why:
Why were they saying the time had not come? “But the heathen of the land lying heavy upon the inhabitants of Judea, and holding them strait, hindered their building; And by their secret plots, and popular persuasions and commotions, they hindered the finishing of the building all the time that king Cyrus lived: so they were hindered from building for the space of two years, until the reign of Darius.”

They had secret plots, persuading the multitude to go against us and causing commotions. This is why it is important to read your four chapters a day; captains, make sure your soldiers are reading, so that they read the whole Bible by the end of the year.

“Consider your ways” means examine yourself. “Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?” If you don’t know Christ is in you, you are reprobate.

Don’t say that is only for Zerubbabel. That is what all of us have to do: examine ourselves day by day.

sense.text: The word came by Haggai again to Zerubbabel the governor, to Joshua the high priest, and to the residue of the people.

They were in Babylon for 70 years; Persia came at the end of the 70 years, Cyrus and then Darius and Artaxerxes. So the question is, who is still alive that saw the temple Solomon built? “Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory? and how do ye see it now? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing?” When they rebuilt the temple, it did not look half as good as what Solomon had built.

The temple Zerubbabel rebuilt was completed around 515 BC. Then in the time of Rome, King Herod the Great, an Edomite, began a massive expansion and renovation of the second temple around 20 or 19 BCE, because it did not look good in comparison with Solomon’s: to beautify the site, to impress the Roman world, and to win favour with his Jewish subjects. He doubled the Temple Mount platform with giant retaining walls, used enormous white limestone blocks, covered the main building in bright white stone trimmed with gold, and added colonnades, magnificent gates, and spacious public spaces for worshippers and pilgrims.

That last part means the other nations now had a place where they could come and look at what was going on in the temple. That was not in the original design God gave us. Herod added it.

precepts.why: “But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy”. The old men who had seen Solomon’s temple cried with a loud voice, “so that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people”. The house they were building was as nothing in their eyes compared with the first.

“And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.” Who are the violent Christ was talking about? Rome.

Herod, who renovated the temple, was an Idumean, and Rome were Idumeans: the same race. The violent who took it by force were Edom.

“The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy”. Who is he talking about? Rome, Edom. “I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.”

Esau’s own book, Who Is Esau-Edom by Charles A. Weisman, says Herod was a shrewd and unscrupulous tyrant, despised by the Judites because he was an Idumean, an Edomite, and not one of their own stock. Herod hated the people of Judah: one of his first acts was to execute 45 of their leaders, and he destroyed the priestly line of Hyrcanus, the line of the Maccabees, the last being Antigonus, who taunted Herod with his Idumean origin and said the kingdom should fall to one of the royal family. That is why Herod beautified the temple, to get in the good graces of the people.

In the years just before Christ, Judea was controlled by an Edomite faction who usurped the Judite name, land and heritage: they said we are Jews now, we are converts. Historically Edom became known as the Jews, derived from Judea and from Judah, though they were never of Judah or Israel. Look at the white folks people call the Jews: the Sephardic, the Spanish Jews, and the Ashkenazi of Poland, Russia, Germany and western Asia, who make up 90 percent. We were in Spain first; when they conquered us and cast us out, Esau became the Sephardic ones. The Jewish Encyclopedia of 1905 says the main stock of the Jews came from the Khazars, and the Khazars are of Edomite stock, the original stock coming from the land of Edom.

God hates Esau, and calls them the people of his curse. If you knew you were the children of the devil, you wouldn’t want anybody to know it. That is why they form the Anti-Defamation League, put people on hate lists and push hate-crime law, and why they infiltrate the churches, saying the hate of Romans 9:13 does not really mean hate. That is the game now against the truth.

sense.text: “Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!” Herod made that temple look so good that the disciples said, Lord, look at the temple, look how beautiful it is.

“There shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.”

The Temples That Jerusalem Forgot, by Ernest L. Martin, shows his prophecy was accurate to a T: when the Romans got through dismantling Jerusalem and the temple, no stones were left in place that would make one believe there was once a city or a holy sanctuary there. Scholars cannot find any stone of the temple still in its original place.

The Wailing Wall was not a wall of the temple. It is the western wall of Herod’s fort, Antonia. Christ said not one stone would be left, and the temple was totally destroyed, yet every year masses go to pray at that wall, Herod’s fortress. And that davening is a sexual thrust; that is not how they prayed in the scriptures.
“Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?” Their question: when shall the end come, and when will this temple be destroyed?

precepts.why:
Look at the plan of Herod’s temple: the court of the Gentiles, meaning the other nations, then the women’s court, the men’s court and the priests’ court.

“Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein. But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles”. God said don’t measure that. Why? That is where the other nations went. Herod added it, but it was not part of the original temple.

The argument is that God is for everybody. Leave it out, measure it not: God ain’t for everybody.

“Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up. Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?” Christ was speaking of a temple, but not the one Herod built.
“We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.” This is what the false witnesses said against him.

This is Christ on the cross: “And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, Save thyself, and come down from the cross.” So we know Christ was talking about his body.

“Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.” That is what he meant when he said in three days I will build this temple again. They overheard his teachings, and those false witnesses who said he would destroy the temple and build it back were lying on him.

This is what he actually said: “how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.” Raising himself up the third day: Christ’s body was the temple. And his temple today is us.

sense.text:
How do we grow in this truth: individually, as a congregation, in our marriages, as an officer, as a soldier? Everybody goes to the milk and misses verse 1. “Wherefore laying aside all malice”: you have to put away first all the malice that is within you. “And all guile”: guile means deceit. “And hypocrisies, and envies”: envies are jealousies. “And all evil speakings”: all murmurings and complainings.

A brother was demoted last week for lying over a simple thing. Most of the time, when we ask you, we already know the answer; we call the witnesses, and now you are found out as a liar and deceitful, not worthy of your rank. That is why some brothers stay away from the war room.

Zerubbabel got to his position not just by his fighting skills, but by noble character and understanding God’s truth. We should all walk in the footsteps of Zerubbabel, and not be deceitful, envious, hateful, full of guile with one another. Frederick Douglass said it is easier to build strong children than to repair broken men. All of us came in broken, broken with sins.

“As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word”. The sincere milk of the word is the law, God’s laws. Be like a newborn baby: we have to be drinking the laws of God the way a baby drinks milk. Not once a month, not once a week, but every other hour, in that Bible study. “That ye may grow thereby”: that is the only way you are going to grow, as an individual, as a husband, as an officer, as a soldier, as a leader.
“If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious”: if you know that this word is true.
“To whom coming, as unto a living stone”: Christ is the living stone, “disallowed indeed of men”, rejected by the scribes and Pharisees, “but chosen of God, and precious”.

“Ye also, as lively stones”: we must be lively stones as Christ was. Lively means the laws percolate within us; have some zeal and passion about yourself. Watching a teacher on the Creole channel, without speaking the language, you can read the spirit, and that spirit was boring. The Spanish channel views were low, and when you see the videos: boring, no fire, no zeal, no passion. We need men with fire when they teach.

“Are built up a spiritual house”: that is the real temple. Wherever IUIC is, that is a spiritual house, “an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.”

precepts.why:
“In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord”. The building is you and me, growing, and Peter just explained how we grow: laying aside all malice, all guile, all hypocrisies, all evil speakings, and desiring the sincere milk of the word.

Fitly framed together: stones have to come together. Brothers, we must merge together. Whatever your position is, play that position. Don’t try to change positions through deceit. “In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.”

“Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you? If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are.” We are the temple. That is why we have to change the way we conduct ourselves; our communications must change.

“Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.” We must depart from iniquity.

“But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver”. This great house is the nation of Israel, the real nation of Israel; we can only speak for Israel United in Christ. There are brothers and sisters who are gold and silver material, applying what we just read in 1 Peter 2:1-2. “But also of wood and of earth”: no good. Brothers and sisters with fringes and a border of blue, here for years, not new people, who have not changed their lives: still grimy, still that secret adulterer, that liar, complainer and murmurer. “And some to honour, and some to dishonour.” In every IUIC school there are both, and the captains must be able to identify who is honourable and who is dishonourable.

“If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.” Purge means cut them off, like pruning a plant, taking away the bad elements. You know which brothers always get you in trouble. Some of them almost got me arrested many a time; I had to cut them off and hang out with leadership.

“This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come. For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers”, and on through “lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God”. These are the things to lay aside.

“Having a form of godliness”: that is the fringes and the border of blue everybody wears, walking around with your Bible saying Most High, Christ bless, heartily. “But denying the power thereof”: you ain’t keeping no laws in your heart; you are not really keeping the commandments. “From such turn away”: the same as the chapter before, purge yourself from these.

“Because ye despise this word”: our people despise God’s laws, the milk of the word, “and trust in oppression and perverseness”. What is oppression? Democracy, for example, is an oppressive system. And perverseness is Christianity: God says come as you are, stay as you be. That is what was learned in church: no change.

Our people want comfortable oppression. Harriet Tubman said she could have freed so many more if they had known they were slaves. They say I ain’t oppressed, I make money, I make ten million a year: that is comfortable oppression, trusting in oppression.

“Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.” You are going to fall.

sense.text: “Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the Lord of hosts.” Everything we do, brothers and sisters, must be according to the spirit of the Most High God. It has nothing to do with our physical powers or our skills.

“Who art thou, O great mountain?” Who art thou, O Babylon the Great? Zerubbabel was in the Persian captivity, and Babylon was already destroyed by Persia. So this Babylon is the Babylon to come, Babylon the Great.

“Before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof”. The headstone is Christ, the saviour. “With shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.” Why crying grace, grace? Isaiah says why: because of the oppressors.

precepts.why:
This shows where the mountain is. “And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the Lord. Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain”. He calls Babylon the destroying mountain, “which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.”

“And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the Lord.” That lets you know it is not Iraq. People still live in Iraq today, and this says desolate for ever. It is not talking about ancient Babylon; it is the great mountain of Zechariah 4:7, Babylon the Great.

This shows Zerubbabel is in these last days. “In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan”: the language of Canaan is the scriptures. “One shall be called, The city of destruction”: one city shall be destroyed.

“In that day shall there be an altar to the Lord in the midst of the land of Egypt”: it is talking about where the Israelites are, here in Babylon the Great, the spiritual Egypt. An altar is used for sacrifice. “And a pillar at the border thereof to the Lord. And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the Lord of hosts in the land of Egypt”.

“For they shall cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.” That saviour is Christ, the headstone of Zechariah 4:7. It is saying the same thing: they cry grace, grace because of the oppressor.

sense.text: “Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel”, be strong, O Joshua, “and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the Lord, and work: for I am with you, saith the Lord of hosts”. “So my spirit remaineth among you: fear ye not.” That is why Christ said he would never leave us nor forsake us, even to the end of the world.

“Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land; And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory”: God will fill his house with glory.
“The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former”. The latter house is the house that Christ builds, and it is going to be greater than the former house that Solomon built.

“Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me”. You may think at first it is talking about John the Baptist. That is a good thought, but it is actually talking about John the Baptist in the last days.

“But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth?” That is how you know it is the last days. “For he is like a refiner’s fire, and like fullers’ soap”: Christ is like a refiner’s fire.

“He shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the Lord an offering in righteousness. Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto the Lord, as in the days of old, and as in former years.”

“And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers”. Growing numbers of black women are leaving the church for witchcraft, worshipping spirits and deities, Oshun, the deity of beauty and sex, and they call it connecting to their ancestors. Sisters come in with crystals: that is witchcraft. Oh no, it’s just spirituality. Brothers, don’t fall for it, or you will have demons all up in your house. God is against sorcery.

“And against the adulterers”: swingers, the lifestyle they advertise to people of color, is adultery. There was a couple among us who swapped partners with another couple for months, and it only came out because he got mad when his wife left him for the other husband. We had to put him out, and now he is on YouTube and TikTok like an all-knowing teacher, and he will not reveal that he was that swinger brother.

“And against false swearers”: that goes into perjury and false statements. “And against those that oppress the hireling in his wages”. You might say this does not apply to us, but it took place right here: brothers started a trucking business together, and the one with his own authority gave the brothers he liked the good, high-paying jobs and the others little work; some were paid late and not paid the same. Everything was unjust. “The widow, and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger from his right, and fear not me, saith the Lord of hosts.”
“For I am the Lord, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.” That is why we are still in existence today: twelve tribes.

precepts.why:
“Remember ye the law of Moses my servant”. “Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the Lord”: that is still John the Baptist, but in the last days he would be Elijah, the messenger of Malachi 3:1.

“And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children”: because we would forget who we are and lose our way. “And the heart of the children to their fathers”: he is going to show us our forefathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, “lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.”

This is what it means, the refiner’s fire and the fullers’ soap. “Two parts therein shall be cut off and die”: two out of every three of our people shall be cut off and die. Why? Because we are no damn good. “But the third shall be left therein”: one third is going to be saved from this land, America.

“And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The Lord is my God.” That is the wilderness.
What is the offering of Judah and Jerusalem? “In every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name shall be great among the heathen, saith the Lord of hosts.”

“Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.” That is why God will be a swift witness against the sorcerers. Black women leaving the church for witchcraft, sisters bringing in crystals and calling it spirituality: it is witchcraft.

What is adultery? In the sit-down, the Christian could not explain it. “If a man be found lying with a woman married to an husband, then they shall both of them die, both the man that lay with the woman, and the woman: so shalt thou put away evil from Israel.” The swingers’ lifestyle is adultery.
What is a false swearer? “And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the Lord.” That goes into perjury and false statements.

“Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.” This is oppressing the hireling in his wages: a brother paid late, not paid the same, given less work because the one in authority liked other brothers better. Don’t get mad; get glad.

“Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child. If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry; And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.” This is why the Lord will be a swift witness against those who oppress the widow and the fatherless.
